mesh_write_ply — FILEIO mesh op

• Data kinds: table → file

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.mesh_write_ply(table, *, binary) (to call the implementation directly, import fileio; fileio.mesh_write_ply(table, *, binary); from the registry, opsfileio.get("mesh_write_ply"))

Usage

Write vertices, faces, colors, normals, and arbitrary scalar attributes as ASCII or little-endian PLY (text / bytes).

> The detailed description below is the original text — the summary and the headings are translated.

table は vertices と任意の faces/colors/normals/attributes を持つ。binary=False は ASCII 文字列、binary=True は binary_little_endian bytes。色は最近傍整数へ丸める。

呼び出し例: mesh_write_ply({"vertices": v, "faces": f}, binary=True)。
